content.project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: PSD2 open banking connectors
components.description: AIS/PIS integration with Spanish banking aggregators, consent management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows aligned with EBA guidelines.

components.name: Mobile banking REST API
components.description: Versioned REST endpoints for accounts, transfers, and notifications with OpenAPI documentation and request signing for mobile clients.

components.name: Observability and audit logging
components.description: Structured audit trail for financial operations, Prometheus metrics, and centralized log shipping for regulatory review.
